_doc: Coverage cells shared by the recorder, the pipeline and the evaluation harness. All lengths are physical pixels.
direction_convention: theta = atan2(dy, dx) in screen coordinates (x right, y down), in degrees [0, 360). Bin k is centred on 30k degrees: 0 = right, 3 = straight down, 6 = left, 9 = straight up.
size_convention: Target extent along the movement direction: the chord through the target centre along the start-to-centre line (the diameter for circles). Size bin edges are the geometric midpoints between centres.
_goal_doc: Coverage goal shown on the recorder heatmap. The handoff asks for 15 (about 6,000 movements); lowered to 5 (about 2,000) on 2026-10-08 at the owner's request, to be revisited once the test sessions show whether more data still helps. Display only: target steering always favours the emptiest cells.
